description.title: הגדרות הוצאות והוצאות שכר טרחה
description.summary: This table defines the fees and expenses related to legal defense covered by the insurance policy. It details how advocate fees and other costs are calculated in the context of criminal proceedings and claims.
description.embed_passage: פוליסת מכלול מגדירה את שכר הטרחה של עורך דין לטיפול בהליכים משפטיים בהתאם לתקנות לשכת עורכי הדין (שיעור מומלץ מינימלי) 5760-2000, או כללים הנוגעים לשיעור המינימלי עבור שכר טרחה כפי שנקבע בחוק, מעת לעת. העלות כוללת גם הוצאות כמו אגרות, העתקי פרוטוקולים, דמי עדים ומומחים שנקבעו על ידי בית המשפט.
notable_values: Bar Association Rules: Minimum Recommended Rate

sketch:
7.5.3.3  Definitions of defense expenses and fees
7.5.3.3.1 Definition of fees
Advocate's fees for handling the legal proceedings as set down in the Bar Association Rules (Minimum Recommended Rate) 5760 -2000, or rules concerning the minimum rate for legal fees as prescribed by the law, from time to time; or lawyer's fees according to the insurer's customary minimum rates for representing insureds in criminal proceedings - the highest of them.
7.5.3.3.2 Definition of defense expenses Fees as defined above which are paid to advocates for handling a claim, for defense in the event of a claim, in a compromise arrangement, in arbitration and/or an appeal in regard to a claim, including the cost of issuing a bank guarantee in accordance with the insurer's demand as stated in this extension, levies, protocol copying, witness fees and/or expert fees as determined by the court, incurred by the in connection with the criminal proceedings or appeal proceedings -except for any fine, compensation or punitive payment imposed in the framework of a sentence and/or a judgment.
